title: 7.01 / File Access
slide_intent: Use supplied artwork and specify production needs so another person can provide an appropriate asset.
strategic_value: Controlled source files can protect Spectrum’s mark from local reconstruction and reproduction errors.

practical_value: Prepare an asset request containing location, date, production specifications, dimensions and contact information.
